name: elevation
title: Elevation
description: A stacked box-shadow elevation scale for surfaces: soft layered shadows on light, painted highlights on dark, eight levels to choose from.
author: Josh Miller <https://codepen.io/jshmllr>
docs:
Installed `Elevation`. Import it from `@/components/ui/elevation` and give it a size, a radius and a background: `<Elevation level={2} className="size-40 rounded-3xl bg-card" />`. It sets only the shadow.

`level` is 0 to 7. The light scale (0 to 6) stacks one more soft layer per step, doubling offset and blur; the dark scale (0 to 7) paints light instead (an inset top highlight and ring) because shadows barely show on dark. `mode="auto"` (the default) follows the theme (`.dark`, `[data-theme="dark"]` or the system); `"light"` or `"dark"` picks a scale outright. Level 7 repeats level 6 on the light scale.

Colors are the `--elevation-*` variables (light and dark). Under `prefers-contrast: more` an edge is drawn; under forced colors it is a system-colored outline.

Ported from the CodePen "Shadow Stacking I" by Josh Miller (MIT, copyright 2026 Josh Miller, a fork of his "Shadow Stacking II"); the license text is in the file.
